info.bio:
There is more than one artist with this name, including: 
1) Bloodstone is an American R&B, soul, and funk group, most popular in the 1970s and early 1980s.
2) Bloodstone was a Swedish death metal band formed in 1991. 
3) Bloodstone is a metal band from Singapore. 
4) Bloodstone is a melodic hard rock band from Australia. 
5) Bloodstone is a British stoner metal/death metal four-piece from Corby. 
6) Bloodstone is a German melodic power metal band from Stuttgart.

scenes.book: Funk: The Music, the People, and the Rhythm of the One
scenes.author: Rickey Vincent
scenes.desc: Tras la Bomba de James Brown, el soul dio un giro radical: el acento en el primer tiempo se oyó en «Superstition» de Stevie Wonder, «Inner City Blues» de Marvin Gaye y «Cloud Nine» de los Temptations; lo que empezó como un efecto se volvió norma, y el jam funk pasó a ser imprescindible para que un artista negro llegara a la gente en los setenta. Marvin Gaye preguntó «What’s Goin’ On».

podcast.title: Move to London (1971)
podcast.body: The founding members, originally from the "ghetto of Kansas City," moved to London in 1971 because there was too much competition for recording contracts in Los Angeles. "they went there in 1971 because there was just too much competition for recording contracts in Los Angeles."

podcast.title: Ozark Festival Reception (1974)
podcast.body: At the Ozark Music Festival, MC Wolfman Jack announced Bloodstone as a "band from London," which led the audience to expect a white rock band, perhaps similar to The Rolling Stones. As an African American R&B band, their music did not fit the audience's expectation of rock or bluegrass, resulting in fans throwing objects and shouting for them to leave the stage. "They did not like what they heard and they let the band know it by throwing things at them and shouting encouragement for them to depart the stage."

podcast.title: Disco's Impact
podcast.body: Like many R&B groups, Bloodstone's career was significantly affected by disco, until they later re-emerged on the legacy circuit. "Like a lot of R&B groups, Disco kind of did them in until they re-emerged on the legacy circuit."
